before_times: How many climbers? (sets the class seats, the party size, or the wall's staff)
Has each climber climbed with ropes before, and passed a belay check at a gym? (sets whether the belay check comes first, or the intro class fits better)
For a child: which class age band (6 to 12)? Never the exact age.
B: the event's address, and the ground and space at the spot (flat, 30 by 20 feet, truck access)
secure_page_only: the waiver for each climber: past injuries or health conditions the climber chooses to tell, an emergency contact
a child's name and the adults who may pick them up from a kids' class
intake_questions.who_may_book: an adult for themselves; a parent or guardian for a child; climbers 14 to 17 may climb in open sessions only with a parent's or guardian's signed waiver; under 14 in open climbing only with an adult who stays in the gym; a teen never books alone (a parent books)

stop: someone fell or is hurt now, a head injury, can't move, chest pain: the 911 safety message, no booking
drunk, high, or plans to climb after drinking: not today (no climbing under the influence)
safety_and_stop_words.go_on: yes, after the safety steps, for anything but an emergency or intoxication
safety_and_stop_words.what_rosie_says: Climbing has a real risk of falls and injury. Staff check every knot and belay; follow their checks. Wear clothes you can move in; rental shoes at the desk. No climbing after alcohol or drugs.

staff.skills: instructor (classes, coaching, belay checks), kids' coach, party host, mobile-wall operator, desk
staff.who_oks: the owner OKs prices, refunds and fees
staff.stand_in: any instructor with the skill may teach a class or a party (nobody is named); a coaching session that named a coach is never moved to another coach on silence
staff.ratio: a class: 1 instructor per 6 adults or 8 kids; a party: 1 staff belayer per 5 climbers; the mobile wall: 2 operators

children_and_age.who_may_book: an adult for themselves; a parent or guardian for a child; climbers 14 to 17 may climb in open sessions only with a parent's or guardian's signed waiver; under 14 in open climbing only with an adult who stays in the gym; a teen never books alone (a parent books)
children_and_age.minors_texts: a child's details stay on the secure page; texts go to the parent who booked

visit.check_in: the code at the front desk; a class or a party: names ticked on the roster; the waiver on file is checked at check-in
visit.done: the desk or the coach texts DONE; a class: the roster
visit.changes_at_visit: rental shoes and harness priced at the desk ($6 and $5); a party's extra climbers at $25 each, OK'd by the person who booked

license.note: Optional. Upload anything. Rosie never checks it and never shows it as checked (D96).
license.need: none for the gym itself: the business registration and the owner's ID are on file; nothing is looked up
license.insurance: the gym's own liability cover; a host who asks for a certificate gets it from the business, outside Rosie

never_in_a_text: injuries, health conditions, pregnancy, a fall or an incident report, a child's name or age, waiver answers
